summary: Zhibao Technology Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, disclosing a PIPE financing agreement with non-U.S. investors. Under the Securities Purchase Agreement, the company will issue 442,000,000 units, each comprising one Class A ordinary share and a warrant, for an aggregate purchase price of 2,380 Bitcoin, approximately US$154.7 million based on $65,000 per Bitcoin. The warrants have an exercise price equal to the unit price and a two-year term. Closing is expected within twelve business days, subject to customary conditions, including Nasdaq compliance and sufficient authorized capital. The PIPE proceeds will bolster the company's Bitcoin reserve, which is projected to reach approximately 2,380 Bitcoin post-closing. Board and management changes accompany the transaction.
